title: YOLOX (tiny / S / M / L / X)

Details
  • Paper: YOLOX: Exceeding YOLO Series in 2021, arXiv, 2021-07-18
  • Original code: https://github.com/Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX at 6ddff4824372
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX/blob/6ddff4824372906469a7fae2dc3206c7aa4bbaee/LICENSE (Apache-2.0); https://github.com/Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX/releases/tag/0.1.1rc0 (the weights)
  • Training data: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations) (COCO 2017 train, 300 epochs from scratch (no ImageNet pretraining; Ge et al. 2021, section 2.1))
  • Options: score_threshold = 0.05 (0.0 to 1.0), max_detections = 100 (>= 1), cuda_graphs = True (speed only)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: yolox-tiny, yolox-s, yolox-m, yolox-l, yolox-x
  • Outputs: boxes, scores, labels; label_set: coco-80
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): yolox-tiny 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); yolox-s 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); yolox-m 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved); yolox-l 3000x4000 (0.6 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved); yolox-x 3000x4000 (0.7 GiB peak allocated, 0.7 reserved)
  • yolox-tiny 800x1344, first call: portable + torch.compile 13 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 24 s (ONNX + engine).
  • yolox-s 800x1344, first call: portable + torch.compile 13 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 17 s (ONNX + engine).
  • yolox-m 800x1344, first call: portable + torch.compile 13 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 20 s (ONNX + engine).
  • yolox-l 800x1344, first call: portable + torch.compile 15 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 21 s (ONNX + engine).
  • yolox-x 800x1344, first call: portable + torch.compile 16 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 24 s (ONNX + engine).
  • yolox-tiny original 800x1344: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX@6ddff4824372 ValTransform (CPU cv2) + model + postprocess (NMS 0.65), score 0.05 (card default), all in the timed call
  • yolox-s original 800x1344: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX@6ddff4824372 ValTransform (CPU cv2) + model + postprocess (NMS 0.65), score 0.05 (card default), all in the timed call
  • yolox-m original 800x1344: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX@6ddff4824372 ValTransform (CPU cv2) + model + postprocess (NMS 0.65), score 0.05 (card default), all in the timed call
  • yolox-l original 800x1344: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX@6ddff4824372 ValTransform (CPU cv2) + model + postprocess (NMS 0.65), score 0.05 (card default), all in the timed call
  • yolox-x original 800x1344: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX@6ddff4824372 ValTransform (CPU cv2) + model + postprocess (NMS 0.65), score 0.05 (card default), all in the timed call
  • yolox-tiny load / first call: original 1.55 s / 0.515 s, portable 0.18 s / 1.31 s, kernels 1.58 s / 0.307 s
  • yolox-s load / first call: original 0.22 s / 0.03 s, portable 0.15 s / 1.346 s, kernels 1.55 s / 0.303 s
  • yolox-m load / first call: original 0.32 s / 0.032 s, portable 0.24 s / 0.356 s, kernels 1.6 s / 0.192 s
  • yolox-l load / first call: original 0.65 s / 0.032 s, portable 0.41 s / 1.164 s, kernels 1.72 s / 0.359 s

  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Limitations

  • The image is resized like OpenCV 4's 8-bit INTER_LINEAR (what the reference calls); OpenCV 5 resizes differently by up to two grey levels, so a reference run on OpenCV 5 differs slightly.
  • Boxes are not clamped to the image, as upstream: at the right or bottom border they can reach a few pixels into the padding.
  • One label per box (the cell's best class), as upstream: a cell does not report a second class.
